notes.subject: rehe
notes.rationale: Hebrew lacks a preposition on בהמות; avañeʼẽ needs 'rehe' to mark the thing asked about

notes.subject: ombo'éta
notes.rationale: ותרך from ירה, literally 'throw/flow (like water)', here 'teach' — the water image is lost

notes.subject: to Job
notes.rationale: Imperatives שאל and נא summon the addressee to question the animals directly

notes.subject: ותרך
notes.rationale: Some read 'let them teach you' (from ירה II) vs 'they will correct/instruct you'; chosen: teach

translation: Upéicharamo jepe, ejerure ko'ág̃a mymbakuéra rehe, ha ombo'éta ndéve; ha guyrakuéra yvágagua, ohechaukáta ndéve.
